opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir.; Motions for leave to amend petition for writ of cer-tiorari and for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded to United States District Court for the Northern District of Ohio for reconsideration in light of suggestion contained in the Solicitor General’s memorandum filed December 16, 1970.
